title: Horror from the Deep
start: Talk to Larrissa, who is outside of the Lighthouse, north of the Barbarian Outpost.

items.t: 2 normal planks (can be obtained during the quest, just north of the fenced-in area of the Barbarian Outpost)
A sword of any type that you are willing to lose
An arrow of any type (except ogre and training) that you are willing to lose

recommended.t: A melee weapon (ideally a slash weapon), a ranged weapon (ideally thrown weapons), and magic weapon plus runes for all four elemental spells to switch amongst in combat. Necromancy does not work against the Dagannoth mother.
Games necklace and quick teleport tabs are very helpful to reach the Lighthouse during the quest.
Houses by Rellekka are also helpful transportation methods.
Lighthouse Teleport for quick teleportation to Larrissa

rewards.t: A damaged god book of your choice
The Dagannoth Mother is unlocked in the Dominion Tower

Access to The Lighthouse Store and the dagannoth caves underneath (There are level 77 and 78 dagannoths. The level 77's use an inaccurate ranged attack, while the level 78's use a much more effective melee attack)
The ability to request dagannoth as a Slayer assignment if the Mask of the Dagannoth is owned

steps.t: Head to the lighthouse north of the Barbarian Outpost and talk to Larrissa. [Chat: 1 With what? › 1 But how can I help? › Accept › 3 I'll see what I can do]
p: Fixing the bridge to the Lighthouse.

steps.t: Go south to the Barbarian Outpost, pick up two planks north of the Agility course.
Enter through the gate, then go through the Obstacle pipe.
Talk to Gunnjorn. [Chat: 1 Talk about Horror from the Deep.] (Make sure to have 1 free inventory slot)
Far east of Larrissa, go to a broken bridge, just past the crystal tree.
Fix the bridge from both sides (you can cross the bridge after the first side is repaired and right-click fix the other side).
Go to the floor 3 and Repair the lighting mechanism three times.
Climb the iron ladder on the floor 1 to go to the lighthouse basement.
To open the strange wall, use a fire rune, air rune, water rune, earth rune, a sword, and an arrow on it. [Chat: 1 Yes › 1 Yes › 1 Yes › 1 Yes › 1 Yes › 1 Yes]
Go down the ladder and talk to Jossik.
p: The fight with the Dagannoth mother.

steps.t: Talk to Jossik again, and then kill the Dagannoth mother when it appears.

sub.t: Strategies can be found here; note that Necromancy does not have any effect on the dagannoth mother. The below table shows her weaknesses in different forms:

steps.t: Go to the floor 2 of the lighthouse.
Show the rusty casket to Jossik.

sub.t: If you had a full inventory when defeating the Dagannoth mother, you will not receive a rusty casket. Instead, you must talk to Jossik, who will have picked it up for you.

steps.t: You may now choose a book affiliated with three gods: Saradomin's Book of Wisdom, Guthix's Book of Balance or Zamorak's Book of Chaos.

sub.t: Be sure to choose the same book twice in a row when he asks if you are sure about your selection.
